title: Machine-learning-assisted multiscale topology optimization of functionally graded superimposed lattice structures
llm_rationale: NN surrogates for homogenized lattice stiffness and density stand in for online homogenization during MMA lattice optimization after SIMP; cost avoidance asserted, no measured comparison in abstract.

title: Multiscale topology optimization of compressible and nearly incompressible anisotropic hyperelastic structures using physics-augmented neural networks
llm_rationale: Physics-augmented NN constitutive surrogates replace microscale solves in concurrent multiscale hyperelastic TO; abstract claims a large cost reduction versus classical FE-squared approaches.

title: Mechanostat-type effective density correction for Carter-Hayes growth applied to topology optimization and its efficient interpolation for a target strain energy and volume fraction
llm_rationale: Filtered SIMP variant with free volume; a physics-loss neural network reproduces about 2,000 plain iterations in 500 epochs and is presented as a fast surrogate.

title: DMF-TONN: Direct Mesh-free Topology Optimization using Neural Networks
llm_rationale: Mesh-free TO with density and PINN displacement networks; claims results on par with conventional TO, a parity quality comparison with a classical method.

title: DNN-Based Topology Optimisation: Spatial Invariance and Neural Tangent Kernel
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 34:27659-27669, 2021
llm_rationale: Theory of NN-parameterized SIMP via neural tangent kernel, linking it to classical SIMP filtering; design comparisons with SIMP plausible in full text.

title: Data-driven topology optimization of spinodoid metamaterials with seamlessly tunable anisotropy
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering, 383, 113894, 2021
llm_rationale: DNN surrogate replaces FE^2 homogenization inside two-scale spinodoid TO; claims an efficient alternative to costly classical homogenization.

title: Scalable Deep-Learning-Accelerated Topology Optimization for Additively Manufactured Materials
llm_rationale: Learned gradient surrogate with parallel HPC training for heat-conduction TO; reports about 8.6x speed-up over standard TO at competitive performance.

title: A Novel Topology Optimization Approach using Conditional Deep Learning
llm_rationale: Conditional Wasserstein GAN reproduces planar TO results; claims very low computational cost relative to conventional algorithms.

title: A novel topology design approach using an integrated deep learning network architecture
llm_rationale: GAN plus CNN topology design motivated by SIMP being impractically slow; no result-level speed or quality comparison stated.

title: One-Shot Generation of Near-Optimal Topology through Theory-Driven Machine Learning
llm_rationale: Theory-guided active learning of a one-shot TO generator; claims to bypass iterative optimization; numeric gains shown against standard supervised learning.

title: Steering topology distributions for unified generative design of architected metamaterials
llm_rationale: Diffusion prior steered toward task objectives for metamaterial topology design; benchmark comparisons stated, classical TO comparator plausible.

title: AutoMS: Multi-Agent Evolutionary Search for Cross-Physics Inverse Microstructure Design
llm_rationale: LLM-guided evolutionary search for cross-physics microstructures; reports higher success rate than traditional evolutionary algorithms and agent baselines.

title: TopoCtrl: Post-Optimization Topology Editing Toward Target Structural Characteristics
llm_rationale: Latent diffusion edits optimized topologies toward target characteristics; claims no re-optimization needed and better results than parameter re-tuning or naive post-processing.

title: Rank Reduction AutoEncoders for Mechanical Design: Advancing Novel and Efficient Data-Driven Topology Optimization
llm_rationale: Rank-reduction autoencoders with MLP latent maps for forward and inverse TO on MBB data; claims fast surrogates; classical comparison not stated.

title: Evolutionary de-homogenization using a generative model for optimizing solid-porous infill structures considering the stress concentration issue
llm_rationale: Deep generative model inside evolutionary multifidelity de-homogenization targets stress; improvement over pixel-based TO is implied but not explicitly quantified.

title: Data-driven topology design based on principal component analysis for 3D structural design problems
llm_rationale: PCA-compressed generative DDTD for 3D stress minimization; motivated by sensitivity-based TO limits, a classical comparison is plausible but not stated.

title: Latent Diffusion Models for Structural Component Design
llm_rationale: Latent diffusion trained on SIMP results generates 3D voxel components; near-optimality implies a comparison with SIMP that is not explicitly stated.

title: NSTO: Neural Synthesizing Topology Optimization for Modulated Structure Generation
llm_rationale: Coordinate-network TO claims much shorter computation than conventional TO plus instant inference of new solutions.

title: Speeding up Computational Morphogenesis with Online Neural Synthetic Gradients
llm_rationale: Online-trained neural synthetic gradients accelerate TO; claims up to 7.5x speedup over the standard optimizer with similar objective on a large 3D case.

title: Towards Signed Distance Function based Metamaterial Design: Neural Operator Transformer for Forward Prediction and Diffusion Model for Inverse Design
llm_rationale: Conditional diffusion generates SDF metamaterials for target stress-strain curves in one shot; implies speed over iterative gradient optimization but states no direct comparison.
